actions.custom_api_call.description: Call any Document AI endpoint. Paths start with the version, for example `/v1/projects/{project}/locations/{location}/processors`.
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.processDocument.description: Run a document through a Document AI processor and get its text, entities, form fields and tables
Comma-separated fields to return, for example `text,entities`. Ignored when Include Full Document is on.
actions.processDocument.props.file.descr: The document to process. Up to 15 pages, or 30 with Imageless Mode.
actions.processDocument.props.imagelessM: Leave page images out of the result and allow up to 30 pages.
actions.processDocument.props.includeFul: Also return Google's raw `document` output. Can be several MB.
actions.processDocument.props.mimeType.d: Leave empty to detect it from the file extension.
actions.processDocument.props.pages.desc: Only process these pages, for example `1,3-5`.
The processor to run the document through.
actions.processDocument.props.processorV: For example `pretrained-ocr-v2.1-2024-08-07`. Leave empty to use the processor's default version.
actions.processDocument.props.source.opt: File (upload or a file from a previous step)
description: Extract text, entities, form fields and tables from documents with Google Document AI processors.
